name: 48933 · Lansing, MI
findings: ZIP 48933 (Lansing) has 255 nonprofit organizations. 161 of them (63%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 150 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48933 (Lansing) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
57% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48933 (Lansing) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.1 times the typical level).

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
